flagged.evidence: Step 5.1 says, “each tooth block B_i has size |B|/ell^2.” But [L3] only yields an (ell,|B|/ell^2)-comb. The cited definition `def-comb-in-a-graph` requires its blocks to form an (ell,w)-blockade, and `def-blockade-length-and-width` defines that as |B_i| >= w, not equality. Thus the asserted exact sizes do not follow and can be false; the available lower bound would suffice for the subsequent inequality.

Step 1.1 moves from “there exists at least one real number lambda” to “Choose such a lambda minimal.” The hypotheses establish that lambda=c is admissible, but do not state a minimum principle or derive one. A nonempty subset of the reals need not have a minimum; here finiteness of G can supply a short finite-candidate argument, but that argument is neither given nor cited.

The claimed direct module check for P_5 is incomplete. Its listed pair representatives omit {2,3} (and its reversal {3,4}); its listed three-vertex representatives omit {1,3,4}, {2,3,5}, and {2,3,4}. Neither [L2] nor [F1] checks those subsets, so the listed cases do not establish the assertion that P_5 has no nontrivial module. Each omitted case is easily split by an outside path vertex.
